integrity: The proof is analytic. The included numerical checker only reproduces finite constants and boundary checks. Literature comparisons distinguish the SAGE-specific rule from classical James-Stein dominance results and do not claim exhaustive novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the no-shift isotropic Gaussian mean specialization with quadratic loss, target mean summary, and \(n_s\ge r+1\). It does not establish a finite-sample guarantee for general SAGE predictors, non-Gaussian summaries, shifted populations, learned encoders, or singular covariance estimates.
title: Finite-summary risk reversal for SAGE step-size adaptation
